Bridge sources & warning levels

Estimated roadway height
About 590.85 m NAVD88. Approach samples: 590.844 and 590.846 m. Road profile source. Straight span roadway profile inferred between intact near-span approaches; no surveyed deck or camber measurement. Retained 1 m Pima County 2021 bare-earth terrain; acquired 2021-10-06. Total elevation uncertainty is not quantified. Sample-window spread is not an accuracy/confidence interval. Deck camber, structural clearance and changes since terrain acquisition remain unknown.
Highest remaining modeled water elevation
586.72 m NAVD88 at 11/2/2026, 5:00:00 AM Arizona time. Estimated road is 4.13 m above that modeled water surface. This is roadway height difference, not under-bridge clearance.
Water source and period
Native SFINCS water surface, 100 m cell 15761 containing this bridge. Issued 2026-11-01T21:09:28.696154+00:00; forecast 2026-11-01T22:00:00Z through 2026-11-02T12:00:00Z. Native zs in the unchanged 100 m model cell containing this bridge coordinate. Not gauge flow or cell-average depth. Bridge opening is not explicitly modeled. Model source.
Bridge warning policy
Channel reference 586.159 m NAVD88; estimated road height above channel 4.691 m. Warning at 590.381 m; roadway concern at 590.850 m; likely closed — model estimate at 591.319 m. modeled water below the bridge warning level. Operator-selected 90% / 100% / 110% policy, not a measured error bound. Channel terrain source. Retained 1 m Pima 2021 bare-earth terrain at the mapped river crossing under this bridge (deck removed). Single channel-ground reference, not surveyed bathymetry or the lowest channel point.
Under-bridge clearance
Underside elevation is unavailable. Roadway height is not underside height; gauge flow in cfs is not water elevation.
Documented flooding or overtopping
No confirmed structure-specific flooding history linked. Generic 2014 Trico Road photographs are not confirmed as structure 09552 and are not assigned to this bridge.
